messages:
noah_sales: Planning final handback for Helix POC. Proposed slot: Fri 08:30 PT. Need owners for: 1) hosted API key revocation, 2) dedicated pool dp-12 drain+terminate, 3) VPC peering and SG cleanup, 4) export/archive logs, 5) legal/data retention attestation. Who can take each?

maya_ops: I can own pool and VPC steps. My procedure: mark pool readonly, drain with 10m grace, then terminate. Commands: 
```bash
rctl pool set dp-12 --mode readonly
rctl pool drain dp-12 --grace 600 --wait
rctl pool terminate dp-12 --force
```
I'll export flow logs before delete.

sec_alan: I'll revoke hosted API keys and rotate any service principals used in the POC. Will run revocation after logs export so audit shows key usage. Example call: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/admin/v1/keys/revoke -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"tenant":"helix-poc","scope":"all"}'
```

billing_joe: Billing note: on-demand GPU stops at termination; reserved commitments still bill. No reserved commit on this POC, so charges will stop. I can confirm final invoice after termination.

legal_sam: Contract requires 90-day retention for specific customer data unless a signed waiver is provided. I can prepare attestation language. If customer signs waiver, we can destroy sooner.

sre_kim: I'll export control-plane and inference logs and upload to a locked S3 bucket: 
```bash
aws s3 sync /var/log/poc/helix s3://helix-poc-exports/1932300001 --acl bucket-owner-full-control
```
Will post the link when ready. Also will mute alerts for dp-12 during teardown.

noah_sales: Owners: maya_ops = pool+vpc, sec_alan = keys, sre_kim = logs, billing_joe = billing, legal_sam = attestation. Everyone ok with Fri 08:30 PT? React with :white_check_mark:.

maya_ops: :white_check_mark: I'll wait for S3 link then start.

sec_alan: :white_check_mark: I'll schedule revoke at T+2 after logs are uploaded.

sre_kim: :white_check_mark: Upload will be done at T-15.

billing_joe: :white_check_mark: I'll prepare prorated info for the customer.

legal_sam: :white_check_mark: Drafting attestation, will post for signature.

ops-bot: Created ticket: POC-43199. Runbook attached: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/poc-cleanup (automated). Will post completion artifacts when done.

noah_sales: Thanks all. Please post revocation audit, S3 export link, termination timestamp, and signed attestation in this thread after completion.
